summary: Tested restored Boxwise Payroll app end-to-end. Backend: 27/27 pytest cases pass (auth, admin endpoints, bulk QR PDF+ZIP, supervisor scan + duplicate + self-scan, payslip PDF/XLSX, payroll/attendance XLSX+PDF, forgot-password). One test skipped because the seeded workers worker.a/worker.b@example.com are MISSING from the restored DB (seed only runs when worker count==0; DB already has 2 other workers). Frontend: Admin login works, all admin pages (/workers /worksites /payconfig /payroll /reports /duplicates /attendance /qr-codes /settings) render without JS errors. CRITICAL: Tailwind CSS utility classes are NOT being compiled — the entire UI renders unstyled (no flex/grid/spacing/colors). `getComputedStyle` on `.bg-yellow-500 p-4 rounded-lg` returns transparent bg, 0 padding, 0 radius. Only CSS variables and the few global rules in index.css are applied. Nav links are visually jammed together (SCANPAYROLLREPORTS...) because flex/gap classes aren't resolving.

minor.issue: Seed sample workers (worker.a@example.com / worker.b@example.com) only inserts when total worker count == 0. On restored DB with pre-existing workers (fitri.valencia.timothy08@gmail.com, drakawei@gmai.com) the documented seed accounts never get created, so the login credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md are stale.

ui_bugs.issue: Tailwind utility classes do not compile — UI renders completely unstyled. Root cause: tailwindcss & autoprefixer are not listed in frontend/package.json dependencies, so react-scripts 5 (the `start` script) skips the Tailwind PostCSS plugin by design (CRA v5 only enables it when tailwindcss is a direct dependency). `postcss.config.js` references `tailwindcss: {}` and node_modules has tailwindcss@3.4.19, but CRA will not load it unless declared in package.json. The restored tailwind.config.js therefore has no effect at dev/start time. All screens (login, admin dashboard, tabs, worker dashboard, mobile) are affected.

issues: No padding / gap / color / border-radius / card styling — pages look like raw HTML with only base font + custom .font-heading from index.css applied.

action_items: CRITICAL — restore Tailwind pipeline. Two options (both unavoidably touch package.json, which conflicts with the user's 'do not change frontend/package.json' instruction — flag this to the user):

(a) Add `tailwindcss`: `^3.4.19` and `autoprefixer`: `^10.4.0` to frontend/package.json devDependencies, then `yarn install` and restart frontend. This is the recommended Create React App v5 Tailwind setup.

(b) Change `scripts.start` from `react-scripts start` to `craco start` so the existing craco.config.js + postcss.config.js (which already references tailwindcss) controls the build. This also requires editing package.json.

Re-seed worker.a@example.com / worker.b@example.com (or document the actual admin-created worker emails) so the credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md match the DB — e.g. make seed idempotent (upsert by email) instead of `if worker_count == 0`.
After Tailwind is fixed, re-run frontend regression (nav, QR codes page, duplicates review, mobile viewport).

`tailwindcss` / `autoprefixer` / `postcss` are used by the build pipeline but absent from package.json — any clean `yarn install` on a fresh checkout will leave the UI broken exactly as it is now.
Seed worker block (server.py ~2770) is not idempotent — once any worker exists the seeded test accounts are permanently missing on restored databases.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE of unstyled UI: react-scripts@5.0.1 (used by `yarn start`) enables Tailwind through PostCSS only when `tailwindcss` is a *direct* dependency in package.json. The commit that cut server.py and deleted tailwind.config.js also removed `tailwindcss` and `autoprefixer` from package.json dependencies. The restored `/app/frontend/tailwind.config.js` + the existing `/app/frontend/postcss.config.js` are therefore ignored by react-scripts at dev time, so all @tailwind directives in index.css pass through unprocessed and no utility classes are generated. Verified by (1) 4 raw `@tailwind` tokens still present in the dev bundle, and (2) computed styles for `.bg-yellow-500 p-4 rounded-lg` resolving to transparent / 0px / 0px in-browser. Mitigation: add tailwindcss (^3.4.19) and autoprefixer (^10.4.0) back to frontend/package.json devDependencies and `yarn install`, OR switch the `start` script to `craco start` so craco honors postcss.config.js. Both require editing package.json — surface this trade-off to the user because their constraint says 'do not change frontend/package.json'.
